_comment: The Morning Skate Almanac - On This Day database. Curated, high-confidence events only. Keyed MM-DD. ASCII only (validator 0.3). Grows over time; a date with no entry simply hides the module.

01-01.text: DeMar DeRozan hangs 52 on Milwaukee in overtime - a new franchise scoring record on New Year's Day.

01-02.text: The Doug Gilmour trade: Toronto lands Killer from Calgary in a ten-player blockbuster that changes the decade.

01-12.text: Washington routs Detroit 41-10 for the NFC title and a ticket to Super Bowl XXVI.

01-17.text: Washington edges Minnesota 17-10 for the NFC championship, one stop short of the goal line at the gun.

01-18.text: Jayden Daniels and the Commanders stun the top-seeded Lions 45-31 in the divisional round.

01-22.text: Washington beats Dallas 31-17 for the NFC title on the way to Super Bowl XVII.

01-26.text: Washington beats Buffalo 37-24 in Super Bowl XXVI for the franchise's third Lombardi Trophy.

01-30.text: John Riggins breaks free on 4th-and-1 for 43 yards - the run that wins Super Bowl XVII.

01-31.text: Doug Williams throws four second-quarter touchdowns in Super Bowl XXII and makes history as MVP.

02-07.text: Darryl Sittler's ten-point night against Boston - six goals, four assists, still the NHL single-game record.

02-12.text: Vince Carter's dunk contest in Oakland - half-man, half-amazing, and the night the Raptors arrived.

02-14.text: The NBA All-Star Game comes to Toronto - the first Midsummer Classic of basketball played outside the United States.

04-07.text: In the Exhibition Stadium snow, the Blue Jays win their first-ever game 9-5 over the White Sox.

04-18.text: Down 3-0 in the Cup Final, the Leafs complete the only comeback of its kind, beating Detroit in Game 7.

04-21.text: Bill Barilko's overtime winner clinches the 1951 Stanley Cup - the goal immortalized by the Tragically Hip.

04-22.text: Darryl Sittler again: five goals in a single playoff game against Philadelphia.

04-25.text: The Commanders take Jayden Daniels second overall in the NFL Draft.

04-26.text: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. makes his big-league debut at the Rogers Centre.
Auston Matthews buries his 60th of the season - the first 60-goal year by a Leaf.

05-02.text: The Leafs beat Montreal 3-1 in Game 6 to win the Stanley Cup - the franchise's 13th, and counting the days since.

05-12.text: Kawhi's Game 7 buzzer-beater bounces four times on the rim and drops - Philadelphia goes home.

05-25.text: The Raptors close out Milwaukee in Game 6 to reach the NBA Finals for the first time.

05-29.text: Gretzky's Game 7 hat trick in Los Angeles ends the Leafs' magical 1993 run one win short of the Final.

06-05.text: The Blue Jays play their first game under the SkyDome roof - baseball's future opens in Toronto.

06-13.text: The Raptors beat Golden State in Game 6 - Canada's first NBA championship. We The North, champions.

06-17.text: Two million people flood downtown Toronto for the Raptors' championship parade.

06-24.text: Draft-night magic: Toronto turns Antawn Jamison into Vince Carter in a swap of top-five picks.
The Leafs win the lottery and take Auston Matthews first overall in Buffalo.

07-01.text: Hometown signing: John Tavares joins the Leafs on Canada Day, announcing it with a childhood bedsheets photo.

07-09.text: SkyDome hosts the All-Star Game - the Midsummer Classic comes to Toronto.

07-30.text: The all-in summer: the Jays land David Price from Detroit two days after trading for Troy Tulowitzki.

09-02.text: After four lost no-hitters in the ninth, Dave Stieb finally gets his no-no, blanking Cleveland 3-0.

09-30.text: The 22-year wait ends: the Jays clinch the AL East, their first division title since 1993.

10-04.text: Edwin Encarnacion's three-run walk-off blast sinks Baltimore in the AL Wild Card game.

10-05.text: Doyle Alexander goes the distance against the Yankees and the Jays clinch their first AL East title.

10-09.text: The Donaldson Dash: Josh scampers home on a wild throw in the 10th to sweep Texas out of the ALDS.

10-12.text: Auston Matthews scores four goals in his NHL debut - no one had ever done it before.

10-14.text: The bat flip. Jose Bautista's three-run homer caps the wildest seventh inning in Jays history to beat Texas.
Mats Sundin's 500th career goal - a shorthanded overtime winner to complete a hat trick against Calgary.

10-23.text: Touch em all, Joe. Carter's three-run homer off Mitch Williams wins Game 6 and back-to-back World Series.

10-24.text: The Jays beat Atlanta in 11 innings in Game 6 - Canada's first World Series championship.

11-01.text: Big-league basketball is born in Toronto: the NBA's very first game, Huskies vs Knicks at Maple Leaf Gardens.

11-03.text: The Raptors win their first-ever game, beating New Jersey 94-79 at the SkyDome.

12-12.text: Rookie Sammy Baugh leads Washington past the Bears 28-21 at Wrigley Field for the 1937 NFL title.

12-13.text: Washington avenges 73-0, beating the unbeaten Bears 14-6 for the 1942 NFL championship.

12-19.text: The NHL plays its very first games - the franchise that becomes the Leafs debuts as the Toronto Arenas.
